newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIAN STOCKS CLOSE HIGHER, PLIVA PEAKS.
newsitem.headline: CROATIAN STOCKS CLOSE HIGHER, PLIVA PEAKS.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly firmer with drugs firm Pliva peaking at a new high amid slower activity on the Zagreb bourse.
* Fifteen of 22 active issues rose, four fell and three closed flat.
* Volume shrank to 14,150 from 24,782 units, turnover fell to 6.4 from 11.4 million kuna.
* Pliva fetched 615 kuna, setting its third consecutive record this week and selling 1,756 units.
* Zagrebacka Banka's ordinaries led decliners, falling 78 kuna or 3.1 percent to 2,505 on volume of 529 shares.
* Fully-listed Varazdinska Banka ordinary stock was the most actively traded issue with 3,726 shares sold. It inched down one kuna to end at 275.
* Top gainer was hotelier Arenaturist, rising 25 kuna or 23.8 percent to 130 kuna with 500 shares traded.
